definitions.ask: How should wake treat a due row whose task is Ready (released, or hand-written on an uncommitted task)?
definitions.why: Release stays final with no exceptions; Alt+Z and bob snooze add commit the task for you

choices.label: Only Next/In Progress tasks wake; a Ready row never revives a released task
A Ready row wakes and is promoted to Next, exactly like a hand-added Task Link

definitions.ask: Which Mac surface should announce a wake?
definitions.why: Bob controls visibility and dismissal end to end, which is what "very likely to see" needs

choices.label: Glass HUD at top-center, 12 s, hover pauses, Open/+15m/× actions; Focus cannot hide it
System banner through NotificationService; simpler, but Focus and alert style can hide it

definitions.ask: Hold the wake notice during a running calendar meeting and deliver it when the meeting ends?
definitions.why: No interruption mid-meeting and no task titles on a shared screen; the beacon still lights

definitions.ask: Add the new Snoozed Task glossary strand?
definitions.requested: As a part of this change, we should add an excellent new glossary term for "snoozed task".
